What could possibly make Ayane that sad? The only thing I could imagine is her catching the mc with someone else in a compromising position.
Oh that's not funny dude! Joking about being pregnant like that. Minus points for that one.
The pain of falling in love, huh? I guess this is the first taste of seeing how badly you could hurt the girls if they fall too heavily for you and they end up seeing you with someone else, only that you haven't seen that yet.
If you see this from Ayane's perspective, you fall madly in love for someone. Further down the line you are given too much time with yourself and too little time with the person you love, you start having panic attacks imagining a future where it was all taken away and you start to blame them for letting you fall so badly for them. Yeah...
I guess it's just easy to forget that the obsessed delusional girl could either end up hurting herself badly or end up taking it out on others, turning yandere as to say. I dunno, rambling.
I thought it was a spoiled brat reaction but no, it was mother nostalgia. I guess I forgot that before the bubble wrap thing they probably didn't have much. So she grew up poor.
Ok, I take it back, redact those minus points from before... I'm not blind, I understand suddenly being rich doesn't solve all your problems. Internally, it probably causes a lot of other social problems. You probably realize that now that you can fix most of your problems with money but social problems can't really be fixed, you distance yourself from the real because the real is difficult. Might be how the dad is handling the situation and the mother ended up hurt too.
It's not just obsession for the sake of love... It's the lack of a father figure. Man, I'm talking too much about this but I suppose this is an important turning point. Also very fitting considering the title of the game.
Oof, that's... that's a very rough choice right there. I guess this is also the introduction to tough decisions. Stay with Ayane, risk hurting Sana, or go home and risk hurting Ayane. I mean, quantity wise, you would benefit more from staying behind but, I dunno... I will just play through it and see where it goes.
Well, it's a good thing Sana is a little oblivious and too trusting...
Also I kinda forgot just now that Ami is waiting for him to come home. I guess she was informed but still.
Going home is the cowards choice. Staying in risky but it is Sana. It would be a different story if Chika was the one feeling down and Yumi came home to see that... holy fuck I can only imagine.
The more I think about it, the more difficult it's starting to seem to just settle with Ayane's. Mikoto, Futaba, Ami and Ayane is all over him. You could easily separate from Miku, Rin, Maya and probably Sana. But something tells me Chika could be difficult and as much as she doesn't want to admit it, Yumi might be hurt about it too, probably feeling horrible knowing the whole job search wouldn't happen and she have her first kiss with him, even if the context was fucked up. Everyone else you he barely knows yet, but there is Sara... She's mature enough to accept the circumstances. I guess this is just the kinda dilemma you encounter when you get too close to too many people at the same time.
What kind of cursed option is that?
Oh, she's on her period, isn't she? Kirin's first event called "partners in crime", they get to the point of sitting at the couch in her home. She's done asking her question and he asks his, wondering why she acts like she wants sex but don't act like it. Then there was some acknowledgement and she went on about that's just how it is to be a woman and that she just can't right now. Like I'm 95% sure she's implying she can't because she's on her period and it's messing with what she wants and does not want to do.
Hmm, he either becomes the teacher of the second group of 10 girls, he stays the teacher of the current 10 girls, they somehow merge to form a group of 20, he gets fired, the game ends or something else. But that could be a long way from now.
His gone 3 months without knowing his the advisor of a manga club... How has no one including Ami not told him about this? Once again the plot fails me.
Ahh... So now we have two girls who hate calling you Daddy, only that selecting that for Ami apparently breaks the world.
Still not able to figure out what to have the characters call us. Having Sara call you daddy works just fine because she seems to be into it but I'm not sure about the others.
I... didn't expect that to work??? I select "brother" and that gave no reaction. Then I selected "big bro/brother" and that gave a reaction.
Seems she's not the only one who reacts to that one. You know, this is PRECISELY the reason why I wanted people to actually respond instead of saying "there are a few others". Yes, so WHAT ARE THEY? I am here for content, not trying to figure out everything. At least I'm making a separate save for the naming sequences so I can come back and check later...
Welp. The reactions to big bro are amusing.
Okay yeah, I am definitely lost. Ayane doesn't react to it but Sara and Futaba does.
Like is there a file I can check for a list of names with special interactions or something?

That is indeed an unlikely situation. Also, I kinda expected the animations to be... worse. I guess I would have known there was animations in the game had I just checked the computer from the start of the game. Oh well.
Yeah ok. I'm gonna until much later to check the second bonus animation. I may have just accidentally confirmed the name of a "former teacher" to a student. I'm going to choose to hopefully forget this and pretend to have misinterpreted that. But I'm probably going to fail.
The room with clocks scene apparently used to have references to pokemon. Wonder what happened there... copyright or something. Game got too popular, dunno.
And Ayane walking in on him in the bathroom used to be A LOT longer and she was a lot more brave. And more stuff happened and... yeah. I wonder what the exact reasons were to cut out this entire thing. I can think of two primary reasons: This doesn't actually happen irl. And, it's not suppose to happen this fast and makes it seem more like a porn game rather than a game with porn. As it was described. Oh I guess another reason could also be that the dev wants it to be harder for Ayane to win him over and it pretty much happened at this moment. Maybe the scene can or does play again in the future instead.
Huh, and I guess the scene the scene where he walks in on Ami in the bath was cut because their relationship is actually closer from the start... actually I don't really know why it was cut out.
So the characters used to be standing a bit further away from the camera back then. Also that dialogue about him telling her she can "walk around the house naked for all I care" was reused later on".
Will continue checking these out later on. Wanna get on with the main story.
...Why the fuck did I just realized what the towns name stands for? Kumon-mi = cum on me... dude, it never crossed my mind to actually try to understand the name. Maybe my mind brushed across it once and then didn't commit...
Ah... I was about to say. I got so confused there. Why did the game decide to go back to normal mode when I'm playing autovn? Well apparently that's because this is a happy event. That's right, the happy event that's been suspiciously sitting in my hints section for 4 days now have finally triggered. Question is, does "rewrite" have anything to do with starting "everything is connected"?
Okay, I see. So this is the first reset event and this is also how you get the happy event. I was gonna ask about the shrine affection thing but it seems the txt I opened up at the start is now becoming relevant.
Oh... great. So now we are exploring THAT kind of fetish. I guess that part about many different fetishes appearing once or twice in the game wasn't false. It's rather suspicious that the length of the necks reach that height, don't you think?
That's not even a real word. Necroanthophilia.
Bro, I didn't expect to laugh during this, wtf!? Something about seeing Maya's expression got me laughing.
Huh. So I guess this nothing is beautiful game was actually made by Selebus before this game and it too is an existential horror?
Somehow seeing HOPE pop out of nowhere felt really weird. But I mean it makes sense. This thing is supposedly God... or was it god? I can't remember.
Ahhh, this feels nostalgic in a way. Hmm, Last Epoch? The end of time? You know... a very unusual place you end up several times throughout your journey. If this will follow the same pattern of several resets, several interactions with this Maya, asking different questions every time, then it feels familiar to things I've already seen. This concept is not new to me, but I can only remember Last Epoch and even that doesn't do this specific thing, only a very similar version. It could also be that it won't happen the way I think and this is just speculation.
The whole idea behind having experienced something an indeterminate amount of times and time looping is of course a common topic.
I hope I'm not gonna have to read the intro EVERY time.
I kind of expected the meeting with Maya to cause the memories to come back. I was so right.
Well I guess I sorta got the answer to the question of what will happen when the school year ends. It resets... for now.
Now how does that work? Time seems to twist and bend in all sorts of ways here. If time really did reset, she wouldn't have been taught those things by Makoto. But that means they are still that much closer to the end of the school year, but I'm assuming they aren't and they started out from day 1, which means... the previous owner of the body which is actually him were there when they were taught those things and he actually remembers being there... I really don't feel any wiser. This is a time anomaly that shouldn't be possible.
Half a year left, 3 months have past. I didn't really keep track but that seems like what this game originally started at. Hmmm. Yeah this is weird.
Not much changed today

Tierlist and character notes and rules.
Being in the "not my type" tier is not necessarily fair but it's less work. Below that tier just means I haven't built a mental profile on the character yet. Children are measured by how fun they are to be around and how adorable they are, overlooking any other factor.
I don't hate any of the characters, I may just find them unremarkable and boring or can't see myself physically attracted to them.
The further top left the character is, the more I like them. Heavily affected by momentary bias.
If I didn't mention someone here, I probably don't have anything noteworthy to say yet.
Tierlists are hard, so the rankings may not be quite accurate to my true emotions and changes over time.
Sex scenes may affect where they are positioned based on momentary bias.
If the color of the tiles are the same, it means they are equally important.

Now how does that work? Time seems to twist and bend in all sorts of ways here. If time really did reset, she wouldn't have been taught those things by Makoto. But that means they are still that much closer to the end of the school year, but I'm assuming they aren't and they started out from day 1, which means... the previous owner of the body which is actually him were there when they were taught those things and he actually remembers being there... I really don't feel any wiser. This is a time anomaly that shouldn't be possible.
Half a year left, 3 months have past. I didn't really keep track but that seems like what this game originally started at. Hmmm. Yeah this is weird.

Tierlist and character notes and rules.

Being in the "not my type" tier is not necessarily fair but it's less work. Below that tier just means I haven't built a mental profile on the character yet. Children are measured by how fun they are to be around and how adorable they are, overlooking any other factor.

I don't hate any of the characters, I may just find them unremarkable and boring or can't see myself physically attracted to them.

The further top left the character is, the more I like them. Heavily affected by momentary bias.

If I didn't mention someone here, I probably don't have anything noteworthy to say yet.

Tierlists are hard, so the rankings may not be quite accurate to my true emotions and changes over time.

Sex scenes may affect where they are positioned based on momentary bias.

I think I'll give as short as I can my thoughts on each girl or at least the ones I like the most (May change my tier list maybe as I remember lol) I also grouped up side characters to their relevent main character.

Chika started out as just another gyaru blond ditz that I didn't think much of her until she started to develop actual feelings for Sensei and we got more of her as the story went. Started to like her but her need to be the one and only I could see disaster, she went up in ranking till the breakdown and her being very aggro with everyone has lowered as a result. I'll add Chinami (Oh just realized she has Ami in her name lol ) as well, I adore her from the first meeting and enjoy the interactions we've had with her so far, also learning that she acts that way to protect her sister and is actually very smart was a nice story element I am all for
Her event where Sensei forces himself on her was the first event that made me pause and get nervous about, thankfully it ends better then expected but had some heart pumping moments there. I really like her, and while her does go up and down in how much I like her she never dropped from her place in the tier, learning about her backstory and this is something I like about Sel's writing is that it didn't feel off or kinda there but actually something important to the plot, I hated the Nodaka scene with her but something about it also made me feel even more protective of her and happy to see how her and Sensei's relationship developed, esepcially now that she's joined the squad and the fact that her hangout event is her going out of her way to be seen with you by Chika. For Yuki on the otherhand I like her enough but she feels too unknown so hit or miss with her
She became number 1 pretty quickly and has stayed at the top as one of the best girls in the story, I love her interactions and her attitude and way of thinking. She is def the girl I would feel the most upset being reset or something happening to her and I just wanna give her and Rin bear hugs all the time.
I adored Sana pretty quickly as I am a sucker for shy types, and seeing her unfold and before more sure and assertive def added to her charm and enjoyablilty. I was very excited when I started seeing her attitude change with Sensei and become more open and comfy (Really wish we got proper lewd scenes with her as for one reason or another it feels normal for her to have that). Sara on the otherhand I was on the fence about until we started learning that she also has been experiencing the supernatural and from that moment is when I got really into her character (She felt kind of one dimentional to me for a while) Also I must of missed something cause I don't know why Sana is afraid of Spagetti and I can't ever remember seeing anything related to that till the cook off where they mention it
She is an interesting character in that I felt the most lust for her first event where sensei walks in on her watching porn and playing with her self, something about being in that type of situation and then joining in as the what was the straight laced up tight class prez type student turned into a nympo just hit the right buttons. Felt shocked when she tried to kill herself on the roof and felt concerned on how it was gonna be fixed. Her later lust event were ok but lost a lot of that first bite and felt like the others, even the latest with Sekai. her Dad dying though was the biggest hit and surprised me that Sel would expand on the war in that way. Maki on the otherhand I feel luke warm about started off quirky and fun but never clicked for me, I like her but if she disappeared I would not really bat an eye or may not even notice
Loved this tomboy ball of energy from the get go, adore her personality and attitude, and the scenes before the disaster between her and Sensei felt very heart warming and the most natural romantically. Her thurma was understandable and I was actually talking to the screen when Sensei didn't know what to do that one time after she got triggered despite being fine to deal with it before. Love Rin too pieces, adore all of her, when I saw her depressed state I legit felt bad and wanted to hug and hold her and seeing her cutting made just want to do something to help. I made sure to go only posititve routes for her and seeing while seeing her heartbroken at the beach I am glad I choose to not also hurt her from my side as well and comfort her. Rika so far no comment on really, just feels like she's there and can't see what she adds to the narrative yet
Now Ami is the girl that I am both fond of and not fond of, protective of and not so protective of. Sekai I'm holding judgement atm due to not being sure what is real of her and what isn't, seeing her up until the flashback and Kyoto trip I was in the lower ranking for her, now I'm waiting for revelations to see how I feel
Maya is another difficult one, her reset self was ok, got on my nerves a bit but when she let that persona crack was when I liked her more. She also felt from day one the charcater that boths wants to hug Sensei and run as far away as she can't risk it, also don't like how know-it-all she could be. After reset Maya I actually like quite a bit as she is a lot more animated and cute, I wish we got more of her and lewd scenes of

The Emrald gardian and the one I relate to as a fellow anime and AVN enjoyer, the Halloween event and seeing it in the other perspective made my stomach drop. Just want to shower this girl with love, attention and lust. Became one of my fav right away and adore her gung oh personality, and the first Halloween event when she starts to get sad about leaving Sensei's class was touching. her along with Ayane and Rin I wanna see happy and satisfied
Another character I was middle ground with, enjoyed her as the story went, understood where she was coming from after the Halloween event so no hard feelings and am now intrigued about where her story will go and what is up with her father, wasn't a fan of the Sekai and her event but she def has one of the better models in-game
Torn about her simply cause I wanna know more first before I settle on how I feel as atm it's adoration and looking forward to seeing more but something is just at the back of my mind that Sel will show us something that will leave me conflicted (Actually do know why I feel like that, due to learning her backstory and getting that picture texted to us by someone) She is super cute and learning more about her being a bit more complex then first seen is enjoyable
want to protect her and make her happy at all cost and learning what I did during Stomachache (The only event I red path and am happy ((So far cause Sel may do an uno reverse flip on us)) I did) Just want her to feel love and even if that doesn't lead to anything more then what they have now I am find, still find when she clings to Sensei in a happy manner super cute and I hope we can take her to the Amusement Park soon. Like her crafting skills and generally hugs and headpats

barely any interest in the girl and when she started dating Rin only cared about Rin being happy, wasn't until the reveal about her actual feelings about Niki, seeing her peaking at Niki and Sensei and going deprived when it comes to the Idol that I gained more interest in her charcater so holding on her for now till we get more

Def one of the best girls and looking forward to more. Felt shocked when she tried to kill herself on the roof and felt concerned on how it was gonna be fixed. Her later lust event were ok but lost a lot of that first bite and felt like the others, even the latest with Sekai. her Dad dying though was the biggest hit and surprised me that Sel would expand on the war in that way. Maki on the otherhand I feel luke warm about started off quirky and fun but never clicked for me, I like her but if she disappeared I would not really bat an eye or may not even notice

spoilers.title: Miku
spoilers.html: Loved this tomboy ball of energy from the get go, adore her personality and attitude, and the scenes before the disaster between her and Sensei felt very heart warming and the most natural romantically. Her thurma was understandable and I was actually talking to the screen when Sensei didn't know what to do that one time after she got triggered despite being fine to deal with it before. When she joins the reset squad (If she does) she will be a very welcome addition

spoilers.title: Futaba
spoilers.html: I started liking her as I thought she would be like a Hinata (Naruto) trope character and could relate to her eating and weight issues but that fell off very fast and while I felt for her during the first lust event that faded a bit when it was kind of pushed what I felt was a bit much on the focus and refusing to get help stuff (I think it's cause I was where she was ((Not purging though)) and just saw younger me and my mentality that I feel I've grown past at this point in my life), also not the biggest fan of her model, after seeing the full on invite scene it looked off to me, not sure why

spoilers.title: Floor Two Girls
spoilers.html:
The Emrald gardian and the one I relate to as a fellow anime and AVN enjoyer, the Halloween event and seeing it in the other perspective made my stomach drop. Just want to shower this girl with love, attention and lust. Became one of my fav right away and adore her gung oh personality, and the first Halloween event when she starts to get sad about leaving Sensei's class was touching. her along with Ayane and Rin I wanna see happy and satisfied
Another character I was middle ground with, enjoyed her as the story went, understood where she was coming from after the Halloween event so no hard feelings and am now intrigued about where her story will go and what is up with her father, wasn't a fan of the Sekai and her event but she def has one of the better models in-game
Torn about her simply cause I wanna know more first before I settle on how I feel as atm it's adoration and looking forward to seeing more but something is just at the back of my mind that Sel will show us something that will leave me conflicted (Actually do know why I feel like that, due to learning her backstory and getting that picture texted to us by someone) She is super cute and learning more about her being a bit more complex then first seen is enjoyable
want to protect her and make her happy at all cost and learning what I did during Stomachache (The only event I red path and am happy ((So far cause Sel may do an uno reverse flip on us)) I did) Just want her to feel love and even if that doesn't lead to anything more then what they have now I am find, still find when she clings to Sensei in a happy manner super cute and I hope we can take her to the Amusement Park soon. Like her crafting skills and generally hugs and headpats
I like her as a charcater and I am looking forward to her story and while I did not like what she did to Yumi her attitude about it and learning more about her personality eased up the dislike a lot. After what happened last update I am intrigued to see where it will go and what will happen now. Also the scene before she kicks the bucket where she seems to be lost, sees Sensei and realizes its the one she knows I felt her relief, Sel did well with that scene. Also her crazy side is a bit amusing, need some proper lust events for her and Haruka.
barely any interest in the girl and when she started dating Rin only cared about Rin being happy, wasn't until the reveal about her actual feelings about Niki, seeing her peaking at Niki and Sensei and going deprived when it comes to the Idol that I gained more interest in her charcater so holding on her for now till we get more
Now like many others I thought she would be just a snoty rich Ojo-sama like charcater I wont really like but boy am I happy to be wrong cause seeing her develop after joining the class has been a treat, love her interactions with Sensei cute and find her starting to let her feelings loose very amusing. Def one of the best girls and looking forward to more. Her mother Tsubasa I'm torn on simply cause I see her going both ways the good and dark, her model is gorgeous and I would not mind her doing more spying on Sensei and whoever he is with at the time (More then likely Chika) as that was fun to see, I am worried about her plans for Tsukasa as like Chinami I adore her and want to just give her the attention that she craves, she cute and funny and I had to do a lot of editing cause I red path her accidently and did not realize till too late(Thankfully I got it fixed) Seeing the previews of the next update I am both looking forward and dreading her role in it
At first Yasu wasn't human and was just an entity related to the gods and religon crazy so I paid her little mind, wasn't until she attached to Touka that I started seeing her humanity start to trickle in and it was the Color White event that turned me over, watching her stand infront of the tv, waiting all night after staring at the karaoke machine and singing softly while tearing up, and saying sorry about being bad. My heart and soul immedialty shot her to the best girl spots that need to be protected and shown love and affection. I started to enjoy her charcacter from there and saw her reglious nutiness in a different angle. My heart broke during the singing scene and swelled when she asked everyone to be her friend (Oh I know but hope nothing bad happens any time soon)
I like her a lot, and always rooting for her when she has alone time with Sensei. Was also dreading that scene when she comes over and has to hide as I knew about it ahead of time. Another girl I hope gets to be happy whatever that is and starts to get wins somehow. I am torn on her, I like her softer side when dealing with Akira but annoyed by her idol side if that makes sense. Like her enough but she loses points on attitude
At first was ok with her, didn't really get into her character for a while, esepcially after her walking in on Sensei and ayane and causing her distress. Wasn't till she started to realize she caught feelings and her reaction to being chosen during the secret battle with her and high Miku where she graduated to cute puppy I need to be firm but loving with, really enjoyed the date and hoping we get some threesome scenes with her just to see how much of a puppy she acts during it. Karin on the other hand, started cute and was the Hinata character I was looking for but due to latest events has fallen to a lower teir till we get more of her and move her story a long

I am torn on her, I like her softer side when dealing with Akira but annoyed by her idol side if that makes sense. Like her enough but she loses points on attitude

spoilers.title: Side/Minor Charcaters
spoilers.html:
at first like Sara was ok with Haruka and didn't become interested with her until the reveal of her darker thoughts that mirror sensei and going into that vow (Ngl wish the scene with her, Nodaka and Sensei on the beach was more fleshed out and longer) Wasn't a fan of her crying during the lust scenes and talking about how terrible she is but eased up on her after she realized what happened to Maki and tried to fix it, somewhat. Not sure if I want her near Rin but am ok if we double team Molly as depending on how that leads up would be very fun/ny
Meeting her the first time and her events are a trip but so very fun, learning about her past was interesting and the stuff being reveled now has me hooked into her. Not sure how I feel about the roof lust event with Nao-chan there just drawing and giving a thumbs up. Nao-chan I wanna learn more about cause everything we've seen so far has me trying to remember any clues or tells when we see her beyond the obvious, also only charcater who's event legit gave me a scare when she pointed to our left, nightmare fuel ngl
I adore Wakana more then I thought I would when she was first introduced as I thought I'd be middle with her like her partner but time and time again she proves how likeable she is and her events and events invlvoing her are enjoyable, Always been a fan of Gothic Lolita and she wears it well. Osako after the hair change and seeing a bit more of her current mind set I am curious on where it is going for her but not in any rush
And Finally other best adult girl. I knew the moment she was introduced I was gonna like her, and so far that hasn't changed, sad to hear her backstory and see her burns but glad she finally got some action with Sensei and in a "foursome" with Wakana and Osako which was both surprisng and hot (Just need more scenes with her and if we also get more of the other two, awesome) Overall I adore her and am looking forward for more

posts.content_html_raw:
GrandAdmiral99 said:
What are some characters that surprised you with how much you ended up enjoying or liking them, for whatever reason?
Click to expand...
I'm going to mostly ignore my first impressions of characters when thinking about who to mention because its probably boring to just list all the archetypes I find boring. There certainly were other girls that I never expected to like that I did end up enjoying. But I think it would be more interesting to mention girls that I grew to disliked but then at some point flipped to liking them, either again or for the fist time.
Tsukasa: No opinion at first and thought of her as a bit of a joke character. Grew to be really annoying for quite a while. But somehow, and I can't pinpoint when, I flipped to thinking that she is actually kind of cute and must be protected/headpated.
Io: At first I wanted to like her, but slowly that progressed to a point where I could not help but dislike her. Which then culminated with "My Indigo(The Blue Death)", "Komorebi" and "Stomachache" where that slow progression to dislike gets turned on its head through these events giving you a relatively effective window into the trauma that shaped the parts of Io I had disliked. And I hope that was the intention with her character because it was quite impactful to go into that event disliking her. It gave me something approaching a feeling of complicity in her trauma through the callous regard I had held her in as a result of her more annoying tendencies. Having those tendencies revealed as only the logical result of the pain she held within herself, the lack of empathy I had until then provided to her character, the nature of what then happens in "Stomachache", and even the simple fact that you have to choose to go through with it providing another less abstract complicity. To my mind elevated Io from a character I did not care about, to one with the potential to become one of my favourites. And that in itself is perhaps also kind of terrible.
Nodoka: Obvious reasons for me to get to the point of disliking her. But how I started liking her is far less obvious. It got to the point where I started to like how much I disliked her. Which I guess then let me look past that dislike and instead look at what and why she was doing things. And then I started to think that the way she was characterised/presented was kind of interesting given the nature of the world her character inhabits. That perhaps she is not just a strange self insert. But instead something I would call a "reverse self insert"(is that even a thing). A character that is attempting to insert themselves into the shoes of a perceived author (God) of their world in order to try understand the nature of their world.(Significant 4th wall destruction ensues. But the 4th wall never even existed in the first place, so why should I dislike its destruction. Something about Bertolt Brecht should probably go here but I don't know enough to say what.)

Additionally, and this wont make any sense, but on the off chance someone understands ill just include it anyway. As a fan of the original eva series I got a very similar feeling towards Mari from the Rebuild of Evangelion movies that I do now towards Nodoka. Not in terms of what I think of the actions of the character, but just the way they fit in my head in relation to the text containing them. It does not really make any sense, even to me. Its the same kind of rare I dislike you but somehow have a strange affection and or respect for your character because I dislike you (but not the way you would a villain) and the oddly specific and compounding metatextual aspects that somehow conspire to warp that dislike into like of the same intensity.
Noriko: Maybe this does not count for my "grew to dislike" requirement because from the start I disliked her about as much as Maya probably would have wanted me to. That was then reinforced by the way she is presented in her early events. But slowly and surely I could not help but start to like her, and in that process also started to think that maybe Maya does not know as much about this world as she would have us think. (I assume that was intentional). At this point I would not be surprised is she made it into my "S" tier in the future.
Ami: I was fairly indifferent to her in the first place. But I slowly started to like her to a point that she was probably "A" tier. But that fell off a cliff with the reveal of "Psycho Ami", for various reasons. Somehow though, the "Prince Ami" arc made me like her again and then the omniscient omnipresent Ami that maybe knew everything from the start that we saw this update only served to further rehabilitate her from "I'm scared of what she is going to do next but its kind of boringly predictable" to "I cant wait to see how deep this rabbit hole goes and how manipulative she might actually be".

Nodoka: Obvious reasons for me to get to the point of disliking her. But how I started liking her is far less obvious. It got to the point where I started to like how much I disliked her. Which I guess then let me look past that dislike and instead look at what and why she was doing things. And then I started to think that the way she was characterised/presented was kind of interesting given the nature of the world her character inhabits. That perhaps she is not just a strange self insert. But instead something I would call a "reverse self insert"(is that even a thing). A character that is attempting to insert themselves into the shoes of a perceived author (God) of their world in order to try understand the nature of their world.(Significant 4th wall destruction ensues. But the 4th wall never even existed in the first place, so why should I dislike its destruction. Something about Bertolt Brecht should probably go here but I don't know enough to say what.)
Additionally, and this wont make any sense, but on the off chance someone understands ill just include it anyway. As a fan of the original eva series I got a very similar feeling towards Mari from the Rebuild of Evangelion movies that I do now towards Nodoka. Not in terms of what I think of the actions of the character, but just the way they fit in my head in relation to the text containing them. It does not really make any sense, even to me. Its the same kind of rare I dislike you but somehow have a strange affection and or respect for your character because I dislike you (but not the way you would a villain) and the oddly specific and compounding metatextual aspects that somehow conspire to warp that dislike into like of the same intensity.

spoilers.title: Noriko
spoilers.html: Noriko: Maybe this does not count for my "grew to dislike" requirement because from the start I disliked her about as much as Maya probably would have wanted me to. That was then reinforced by the way she is presented in her early events. But slowly and surely I could not help but start to like her, and in that process also started to think that maybe Maya does not know as much about this world as she would have us think. (I assume that was intentional). At this point I would not be surprised is she made it into my "S" tier in the future.

posts.content_html_raw:
GrandAdmiral99 said:
What are some characters that surprised you with how much you ended up enjoying or liking them, for whatever reason?

I have a few examples. One is Rin. I didn't really know what to expect from her at first, but she absolutely won me over. She's a fun girl who deserves nothing but happiness. Her boobs are also no joke.

Touka is another. I thought she'd be a bitchy rich girl, initially, but she was the complete opposite. Though she's certainly a stereotypical sheltered rich girl, she has a kind heart and is very sweet.

Kirin's development in later chapters is interesting, to say the least.

Ayane needs no introduction. She's way stronger than I thought possible and I'm kinda rooting for her.

Imani is hilarious and fun, and her and Sensei's relationship is endearing to me.

IDK, just curious to hear what you guys think. And did any girl who you didn't notice much at first become your best girl or waifu?
Click to expand...
I can second Touka, I thought she'd be the dumb and accidentally condescending type the whole time with no other big personality things that wouldn't be drilled into her by some awful event, turns out she's sweet and protective.

Think Miku belongs here too, I'm not averse to Tomboys but she was boring as hell as a pure gym fan. Very un-relatable to me.
Her arc into an explorative and curious girl is really nice to me, just all around a fun chr to be near now.

Obligatory Niki comment, think this one is the biggest for me, I like bitchy girls but it's a bit 2D for a game like this and most of the time the diversion traits for this kind of character is ALWAYS "Oh she secretly cares" but man, Niki is OUTWARDLY caring and kind to Akira in a really heart felt and touching way, I didn't expect her to go to such lengths for someone she cared about and the way she also tried to make Ami feel better is admirable and cute, although boy she's in for a surprise.
Went from a "eh" side chr to a high tier favourite for me.

This also extends to Maya, I thought her "hiding" her feelings was a bit cliché and it got old for me, never hated her or anything but I remember thinking "oh get over yourself" a few times. Most of these got absolutely axed over time as she began to crack under the pressure, and finding out she is like that because she can't love you is heart wrenching.

TBH though none of the girls on this list were people I actively disliked, only were more neutral or uncaring about. They all grew on me massively and I'd list all four in the top sections if I had to rate all the girls.

Tommykjohnson1990 said:
I can't get the latest happy event. The one with the old save wirh Amy in the Mall. Can anyone show what happens please
Click to expand...
Oh cool. I finally get to refer someone to this:

Fire Lord Zuko said:
What is URM?

URM, or the Universal Ren’py Mod, is a helpful tool that allows you to view or manipulate variables and scenes in games using the Ren'py engine in real time. Essentially, it works the same as a save editor. It will save you valuable time, should you ever have need of it.

Where can I get URM?

You can get URM from either this link or in Bingoogus's signature. The download is quick and easy to install.

Where do I extract URM to use in Lessons in Love?

You should see an RPA file inside your URM download. You want to drop it inside the 'game' folder of your LiL directory, like so:

View attachment 4139622

Open the game and your URM will be up and running with Lessons in Love.

Why use URM for Lessons in Love?

Reason #1 - Skips Affection Point Grind

Okay, so… you’re aware of the affection and lust point system, correct? And how you have to waste an entire in-game day to get maybe one affection point per girl? Or even worse, how certain girls are locked to certain days and times during the week?

The URM says ‘fuck that’ and lets you skip all that pointless grind! This will save you countless real life hours that would otherwise be spent clicking through menus and holding down your CTRL key.

Exhibit A - You've started a new game, gotten past the first bit of the story, and now you come to your first sandbox section. You think Ami is cute, and you want to tackle her first. Utilizing your trusty Guide Mod, you open up the Hint Menu and see that Ami's events currently look like this:

View attachment 4139065

Note that Ami has 1 affection point, and needs 4 more to reach her first dorm event. True, you can play her other two events first to get 2 affection points organically, but trust me, the game is far less kind with the affection point system later on, especially post Chapter 2.

So okay, what can you do for the two remaining affection points? Talk to Ami and waste a day? Pftt... No. You have the URM.

Press Alt+M to open up the URM menu, and immediately you should see a search bar. Since we're using Ami as an example, type in 'ami_love', then search. It should look like this:

View attachment 4139037

It should be self explanatory what to do from here. Ami has 1 affection point. Simply click on it and edit to your heart's content! Just... maybe don't go overboard. You wouldn't want to break the game. Just use your judgement and you should be fine.

View attachment 4139038 View attachment 4139039

Ami's affection points are now set to 5 with absolutely zero grinding!

View attachment 4139066

And now you can freely access Ami's first dorm event if you so choose. Pretty useful, wouldn't you say?

By the way, you can do this with Lust Points too, when they become relevant. Simply replace 'love' in the variable with 'lust'. To use Ami again, type 'ami_lust', then search.

View attachment 4139040

You can do any of this with any character, so enjoy having a grind free experience.

Reason #2 - Allows You To Unlock Scenes/Events You Missed

Oh no! Looks like you made the wrong decision and now you missed an entire event in the game! Looks like you’re screwed unless you find another save or start the entire game over…

…is what I would say if the URM didn’t exist.

Let’s use a commonly missed event as an example: Rin’s “I Died With You” event from all the way back in Chapter 1:

View attachment 4139338

Well first of all, how did you miss it in the first place? What exactly happened? Here's a helpful bonus tip: there's an amazing wiki for this game that can really come in clutch when you need a quick refresher or tip on what to do. Except for the Reset Puzzles, but I'll get to that...

Anyway, regarding this Rin event, simply go to the Wiki, like so:

View attachment 4139217

Utilizing the nifty little search bar in the top right corner, type in the name of the event that you're missing. Or in this particular example, "I Died With You".

View attachment 4139218

Once on the event of your choosing, it's as simple as scrolling down and seeing why exactly you missed out on the event in the first place.

View attachment 4139219

Welp, looks like you were a Bad Homie to Rin... You kissed Chika before the Beach Vacation despite Rin telling you not to, didn't you? You scoundrel...

But that doesn't matter! Because with the URM, we can undo that mistake, and it will be as if it never happened! After all, who wants to beg for a save or play through the entire game all over again because of one mistake?

So how do you undo this mistake? Well, there's a helpful section on the wiki that can help with this too.

Scroll up until you see the section titled 'Technical Information'.

View attachment 4139220

Click on it and you should see another section titled 'Event Script Name'. That is our ticket to unlocking missed scenes in URM right there, and precisely what we need to type into our search bar.

View attachment 4139221

'cafe35'. Got it. Let's go back to the game and open URM.

View attachment 4139340

Right away, you'll see the variable is set to 'False', meaning that it never happened. To circumvent this, set it to 'True'.

View attachment 4139345

That should be it, right? Mission accomplished! Well, hold on... We still betrayed Rin, and technically shouldn't have this event to begin with because of it. What do we do about that? There's a variable for this too, which the game keeps track of.

Go back to your search bar and type in 'rinbetrayed'.

View attachment 4139343

Unlike the last one, this variable will be set to 'True', since, yes... we did betray Rin in this particular example. Simply set it to False.

View attachment 4139344

Congratulations! The once locked/missed Rin event will now be unlocked and fully accessible via the in-game replayer. Pretty useful, right?

View attachment 4139339

Reason #3 - Ability to replay one-time-only scenes.

You may be asking... 'well, what the hell is a one-time-only scene?', and to that I say... let me explain.

Scenes you see throughout the game like this:

View attachment 4139382

Event Name: "The Cracking of the Egg (Nothing is Beautiful)" (Chapter 3 Main Event)

This:

View attachment 4139383

Event Name: "Flowerchild" (Chapter 3 Main Event)

And also this:

View attachment 4139384

Event Name: "Flora" (Chapter 4 Nao-chan Event)

These are all moments that you will witness once on your first playthrough of the game, and never again. You can't see them in the in-game replayer, because the event cuts off before it ever reaches these moments. No seriously, go to the in-game replayer and try it for yourself. I have the events listed. None of these moments in the above screenshots will show up.

It can be quite annoying, especially if you're hunting for a particular piece of dialogue, a screenshot, or just want to watch the scene again for yourself.

Well, with the URM, you can! It's rather simple, actually.

I think I'll use the event with Himawari as the example this time, so Chapter 3's "Flowerchild" Main Event.

First, press Alt+M to open up your URM menu.

View attachment 4139438

More likely than not, it should say 'variable names' beside your search bar. This is perfect for when we want to mess with affection points and other variables in the game, but not what we want in this particular situation.

Click on 'variable names' and a new menu should pop up:

View attachment 4139439

Now look, I don't have a problem with the Reset Puzzles personally speaking. I enjoy them in my own way. But I can see why other people wouldn't. The wiki isn't exactly helpful on giving you hints on what to do in them, and neither is Selebus, so... Yeah, it's understandable.

[charactername]_lust = A given character's lust point total. EX: chika_lust

If this variable is True, you are considered a Bad Homie and will miss certain events. If this variable is False, you didn't betray Rin and are a Good Homie. No events will be missed.

amifingered = Is affected depending on if you accepted or rejected Ami's advances towards you in her "No One Can See Us" Chapter 1 Event. If this variable is False, you rejected Ami's advances and are on what's considered the Good Uncle Route. You will miss countless events over the course of the game if you reject Ami, so this is not recommended. If this variable is True, you accepted Ami's advances and actively pursued her, putting you on the Bad Uncle Route, which ironically seems to be better in every way. No events will be missed on the Bad Uncle route.

spoilers.text:
What is URM?
URM, or the Universal Ren’py Mod, is a helpful tool that allows you to view or manipulate variables and scenes in games using the Ren'py engine in real time. Essentially, it works the same as a save editor. It will save you valuable time, should you ever have need of it.
Where can I get URM?
You can get URM from either this
link
or in
Bingoogus
's signature. The download is quick and easy to install.
Where do I extract URM to use in Lessons in Love?
You should see an RPA file inside your URM download. You want to drop it inside the 'game' folder of your LiL directory, like so:
Spoiler:
URM Installation Location
View attachment 4139622
Open the game and your URM will be up and running with Lessons in Love.
Why use URM for Lessons in Love?
Reason #1 - Skips Affection Point Grind
Okay, so… you’re aware of the affection and lust point system, correct? And how you have to waste an entire in-game day to get maybe
one
affection point per girl? Or even worse, how certain girls are locked to certain days and times during the week?
The URM says ‘fuck that’ and lets you
skip
all that pointless grind! This will save you
countless
real life hours that would otherwise be spent clicking through menus and holding down your CTRL key.
Spoiler:
Affection Skip Example
Exhibit A - You've started a new game, gotten past the first bit of the story, and now you come to your first sandbox section. You think Ami is cute, and you want to tackle her first. Utilizing your trusty Guide Mod, you open up the Hint Menu and see that Ami's events currently look like this:
View attachment 4139065
Note that Ami has 1 affection point, and needs 4 more to reach her first dorm event. True, you can play her other two events first to get 2 affection points organically, but trust me, the game is far less kind with the affection point system later on, especially post Chapter 2.
So okay, what can you do for the two remaining affection points? Talk to Ami and waste a day? Pftt... No. You have the URM.
Press Alt+M to open up the URM menu, and immediately you should see a search bar. Since we're using Ami as an example, type in 'ami_love', then search. It should look like this:
View attachment 4139037
It should be self explanatory what to do from here. Ami has 1 affection point. Simply click on it and edit to your heart's content! Just... maybe don't go overboard. You wouldn't want to break the game. Just use your judgement and you should be fine.
View attachment 4139038
View attachment 4139039
Ami's affection points are now set to 5 with absolutely zero grinding!

View attachment 4139040
You can do any of this with any character, so enjoy having a grind free experience.
Reason #2 - Allows You To Unlock Scenes/Events You Missed
Oh no! Looks like you made the wrong decision and now you missed an entire event in the game! Looks like you’re screwed unless you find another save or start the entire game over…
…is what I
would
say if the URM didn’t exist.
Let’s use a commonly missed event as an example: Rin’s
“I Died With You”
event from all the way back in Chapter 1:
Spoiler:
Rin Event Miss

amazing
wiki for this game that can really come in clutch when you need a quick refresher or tip on what to do. Except for the Reset Puzzles, but I'll get to that...

1.) Complete the entire 0.44 and 0.45 Halloween event chain.

2.) Download the URM or borrow someone else's save file that starts at the beginning of the "Amy" Happy Event. You cannot use the replay feature to trigger the new Happy Event. It will not work. If you're borrowing a save and not using URM, skip to step 4B.

3.) (URM only) Open up your URM menu with alt+M. By default, it will say Search in Variable Names. You don't want this. Click where it says 'Variable Names' and change it to where it says 'Labels/Scenes'.

4A.) (URM only) With that set, type 'alexisevent' in the search bar. Click 'Jump' to jump straight to the new Happy Event.

4B.) If you borrowed someone else's save, upon starting the "Amy" happy event and making it to the first choice menu, move left and then forward to reach the Taco Bell in the mall. This will trigger the Happy Event for you.

5.) When you have reached the end, you'll know it when Amy wants to get back to your date. When she finishes talking, ignore this and reload back to your latest save at the end of 0.45. The "Alexisthymia" Happy Event will be marked as complete and you will have a new Ayane profile outfit for your troubles.

The persistent variable 'alexisisreal' will once again be marked as False, and a new variable 'alexisevent' will be marked as True.

posts.content_html_raw:
Day 8 character count 9090
Turns out autovn really doesn't play the sex animation scenes after all... Well that's annoying. Literally have to take autovn mod out in order to see them at least once.
Welp... I guess autovn really is only made for completions sake, following the story, getting the events, you get the drill.

Autovn said there is conflict with hint mod, progress mode I guess. Removing hint mode suspiciously causes errors when I launch the game again. I don't expect this to happen when opening the game, only trying to load a save as been mentioned, but maybe that's just not how it works. Whatever, I wasn't interested anyway, just exploring the technical side (if you can even call it that.

Hmm, is this game even possible to get 100% on without autovn and/or hint mod? Must be extremely hard and time consuming. Maybe the speed at which I'm going at is record time compared to what is expected without mods.

Turns out I can just switch autovn on and the game will return to normal once the scene ends... what did I do before? Why was I under the impression this could not be done? Welp. Back to actually continuing the story.

I guess this is the "cursed birds" event. Honestly yeah, teenage was fucking rough. The analogies are odd but they make perfect sense when you replace what you read with what you interpret. This is the kind of thing we all think about. Nothing really to be said, it just is the way it is as rotten as that which is happens to be.

I guess he was having a midlife crisis or something. Man, it feels like I'm already having one of those. I don't even know what my teenage prepared me for. What did I even learn? I don't even know. I might actually have to ask someone I still have contact with.

"And I refuse to get help for simply being human." This is so funny to me!

How do you uncomfortably or comfortably hate each other? I'm guessing you aren't mentally affected by your hate for the other person if you are comfortable around them. Like, I dunno, angry but not losing energy being angry because you are so used to it for example?

I knew that was coming. Pay to win Ayane.

Well, Rin is not in the best spot right now.
Maybe she hasn't slept much in weeks? I did a quick google to confirm something. Schizophrenia apparently has more to do with sound than sight. I've watched someone virtually whose described it as being episodic and quite severe when it happens. I can't quite recall if they said sound or sight was involved, but knowing what I now should know about schizophrenia, it seems highly likely that's what Rin has judging by her much earlier question about "hearing things you aren't suppose to hear" or something like that. Even since back then I had it in the back of my mind that it could be the case.
Honestly, I would kind of be surprised if it's NOT schizophrenia at this point. But then again, what the fuck do I even know about that anyway? It's not like I suffer from it and have been researching it. Schizophrenia just seems like it would be right up this game's alley with the existential horror theme going on.
Wait... she zones out in class... listening to something? Seeing something? Another piece of evidence I suppose. But the hallway thing seems identical in nature but maybe that's just to disguise her condition. The way the game played out for me made it seem like she really was just zoning out, not that she was looking at Chika.

Thinks things she shouldn't? I must have misremembered. Well it's apparently still a symptom.

Imagining Yumi working at a maid cafe is a glorious thing to imagine indeed. It wouldn't be the first time a cute girl with an attitude has worked at one in these games.

Dude, wtf? Yumi giving me the feels with that low self esteem... "I don't really think anyone's gonna wanna order from any place I'm workin'."
And she instantly ruined it... Couldn't she have just kept showing signs of weakness for a moment longer?

I must be misremembering the whole thing about that lunch. I thought he was suppose to get that and not her but that doesn't make much sense.

Well Haruka just found out Sara sleeps with and are interested in the mc who Haruka just started to like with that phone number thing going on.

Kaori: "Ah! It's you again! Hamburger man!"
Me: "Hamburger man!?"
Haruka split second after: "Hamburger man?"
I swear, the number of times I have the same reaction as other characters.

Suddenly the game throws a yes or no question at me. This is NOT realistic. Give me a "I'm impartial" answer or something! I'm gonna riot!
Doesn't matter what you choose here, Sara still gets mildly/playfully upset.

Friend is a funny word for husband, isn't it?

It took me an awful long time to notice that suspiciously disturbing smilie in the background of Haruka's apartment. It's also facing to the camera and not straight forward. I don't trust that smilie.

Aghh, another decision... I still can't give the indecisive answer. Why?

Oh no, painful memory by Haruka.

That strikethrough text... holy shit. That's the things you want to say but you know will hurt her deeply.

Moment of truth, what are we about to see in Rin's room?
Yep. There it is. The rumored "spoiler scene" I've awkwardly hinted at (or meant to hint at but redacting my reaction to save you quality reading time)
Wait, was there ever a knife involved? I feel like there was but in this scene I think those are just her nails digging into her skin.

Yeah ok, that's NOT schizophrenia. I don't know what that is nor do I know how you would even treat it.
"It feels strangely familiar"... Did the previous owner of the body do this?
Hey, does someone know what disorder Rin might have? If they tell you later on, you don't have to tell me of course.

How are you when you are a box of chocolates?

Rin is giving us that look and I'm not sure how to handle it...

Decided to check that wiki page for names to have the characters call you... uhh wtf is the story behind Sara and "son"!? That's a rhetorical question... Or it might, depends if this already happened and I missed it or not.
I think I just accidentally found out that she had to bury a son, maybe had a misscariage. I honestly don't know. Maybe I will find out eventually...
Well there was a few more words but nothing too exciting.

I'm gonna guess Sara was gonna invite the mc out for dinner under the pretense of it being a scouting mission of a bar. Sana didn't like the idea and started arguing with her mom insisting that she goes instead. Sara was reckless to include him in the plan when talking to Sana and Sana was suspiciously against the idea. Somehow Sana convinced Sara to just let her go instead. Sara told mc the deets and when the mc looked back, she looked upset because it was suppose to be her surprise date but it didn't go to plan and now she's stuck watching the bar. It's of course odd to let Sana go in her stead when clearly Sara cares a lot about this. I can only chalk that up to Sara revealing her and mc's secret relationship to Sana and also ruining her and Sana's relationship in the process if she didn't let Sana be the one to go.

I'm sensing a pattern here. Both Molly and Kaori have eccentric personalities and they both seem to appear at comicically convenient times.

YES! Man I love that! Yumi and mc meets Rin at the cafe and mc's explanation to why they are together is "It's our first date and she's very nervous." I love it!

Oddly specific. Death stranding reference. I mean, I guess it's not much of a reference if you just straight up say the name like that.

She's probably done her fair share of scamming or something...

Oof... that job interview was rough by the end.

And that's the second instance of the dev complaining about patreon and it happened during a Sana handholding scene... how lewd.
Wow, that rant was even more intense than the last.

Kaori just described the mc as being extraordinarily attractive, hmmm.

With a menacing look on her face, Ayane confidently flaunts the sword that will slay her foes when the time is upon us... Or something like that, I dunno, I'm not a writer.

Oh wtf, haha! "Is it really such a big deal if I get turned on by the idea of some other girl moaning my niece's name?"

You telling me the dev actually cares about copyright? That's news to me. The real hamburger man... hmm.

I love that Kaori's way of speaking has rubbed off on the mc to the extent he may now speak like her outside of a Kaori event.

That's very rich there. Of course Yumi isn't going to get over the little incident!

I swear, that has been referenced to hell, hasn't it? "would you like dinner? A bath? Or maybe... me?" example.

Sara did a tremendously good job getting on Ami's good side but this is straight up war between Makoto and Ami, my lord...

Aragofuckyourself BAHAHAHAHA!

Angy Ami is gold!

I kinda expected Ami to lose affection after that exchange.

I'm officially at the half way point in terms of main events... At least that's what it says.

Ah... What do I even say? Yumi is actually hurt? Yeah, like that wasn't already obvious, but damn.

Grassburger, hamhopper, huh.

Haruka: Breasts are way too large for my liking but otherwise she's ok.
Kaori: Her eccentric personality is growing on me. Not a fan of the spider tattoo.


Tierlist and character notes and rules.

Being in the "not my type" tier is not necessarily fair but it's less work. Below that tier just means I haven't built a mental profile on the character yet. Children are measured by how fun they are to be around and how adorable they are, overlooking any other factor.

I don't hate any of the characters, I may just find them unremarkable and boring or can't see myself physically attracted to them.

The further top left the character is, the more I like them. Heavily affected by momentary bias.

If I didn't mention someone here, I probably don't have anything noteworthy to say yet.

Tierlists are hard, so the rankings may not be quite accurate to my true emotions and changes over time.

Sex scenes may affect where they are positioned based on momentary bias.

If the color of the tiles are the same, it means they are equally important.


Some edited since yesterday.
Yumi: I can't WAIT to see how the story with her escalates. Every time he messes with her, it's so fun and I like her appearance too.
Ayane: She's obsessed with you. Her lack of a father figure hurts her more than I realized...
Ami: Red hair, she loves you.
Chika: I expected an annoying gyaru girl who acts way too popular but I got someone chill and down to earth, fun to be around.
Makoto: I love it when he messes with her. I slightly dislike her hair and how studious she is.
Sana: Very precious.
Sara: Hot mom, I repeat, hot mom!
Maya: The mystery behind her is intriguing.
Miku: Not into tomboys.
Futaba: Not into big girls or big tits.
Rin: Nice hair. A bit bland unless Chika is around. Also seem to have a bit of a wingman personality.
Kirin: Surprisingly flirtatious... and intimidatingly so.
Karin: Absolutely adorable how bad she is with boys.
Chinami: So adorable! Must protecc!
Molly: She can be anywhere.

Whatever, I wasn't interested anyway, just exploring the technical side (if you can even call it that.

Hmm, is this game even possible to get 100% on without autovn and/or hint mod? Must be extremely hard and time consuming. Maybe the speed at which I'm going at is record time compared to what is expected without mods.

Turns out I can just switch autovn on and the game will return to normal once the scene ends... what did I do before? Why was I under the impression this could not be done? Welp. Back to actually continuing the story.

I guess this is the "cursed birds" event. Honestly yeah, teenage was fucking rough. The analogies are odd but they make perfect sense when you replace what you read with what you interpret. This is the kind of thing we all think about. Nothing really to be said, it just is the way it is as rotten as that which is happens to be.

I guess he was having a midlife crisis or something. Man, it feels like I'm already having one of those. I don't even know what my teenage prepared me for. What did I even learn? I don't even know. I might actually have to ask someone I still have contact with.

"And I refuse to get help for simply being human." This is so funny to me!

How do you uncomfortably or comfortably hate each other? I'm guessing you aren't mentally affected by your hate for the other person if you are comfortable around them. Like, I dunno, angry but not losing energy being angry because you are so used to it for example?

I knew that was coming. Pay to win Ayane.

Well, Rin is not in the best spot right now.
Maybe she hasn't slept much in weeks? I did a quick google to confirm something. Schizophrenia apparently has more to do with sound than sight. I've watched someone virtually whose described it as being episodic and quite severe when it happens. I can't quite recall if they said sound or sight was involved, but knowing what I now should know about schizophrenia, it seems highly likely that's what Rin has judging by her much earlier question about "hearing things you aren't suppose to hear" or something like that. Even since back then I had it in the back of my mind that it could be the case.
Honestly, I would kind of be surprised if it's NOT schizophrenia at this point. But then again, what the fuck do I even know about that anyway? It's not like I suffer from it and have been researching it. Schizophrenia just seems like it would be right up this game's alley with the existential horror theme going on.
Wait... she zones out in class... listening to something? Seeing something? Another piece of evidence I suppose. But the hallway thing seems identical in nature but maybe that's just to disguise her condition. The way the game played out for me made it seem like she really was just zoning out, not that she was looking at Chika.

Thinks things she shouldn't? I must have misremembered. Well it's apparently still a symptom.

Imagining Yumi working at a maid cafe is a glorious thing to imagine indeed. It wouldn't be the first time a cute girl with an attitude has worked at one in these games.

Dude, wtf? Yumi giving me the feels with that low self esteem... "I don't really think anyone's gonna wanna order from any place I'm workin'."
And she instantly ruined it... Couldn't she have just kept showing signs of weakness for a moment longer?

I must be misremembering the whole thing about that lunch. I thought he was suppose to get that and not her but that doesn't make much sense.

Well Haruka just found out Sara sleeps with and are interested in the mc who Haruka just started to like with that phone number thing going on.

Kaori: "Ah! It's you again! Hamburger man!"
Me: "Hamburger man!?"
Haruka split second after: "Hamburger man?"
I swear, the number of times I have the same reaction as other characters.

Suddenly the game throws a yes or no question at me. This is NOT realistic. Give me a "I'm impartial" answer or something! I'm gonna riot!
Doesn't matter what you choose here, Sara still gets mildly/playfully upset.

Friend is a funny word for husband, isn't it?

It took me an awful long time to notice that suspiciously disturbing smilie in the background of Haruka's apartment. It's also facing to the camera and not straight forward. I don't trust that smilie.

Aghh, another decision... I still can't give the indecisive answer. Why?

Oh no, painful memory by Haruka.

That strikethrough text... holy shit. That's the things you want to say but you know will hurt her deeply.

Moment of truth, what are we about to see in Rin's room?
Yep. There it is. The rumored "spoiler scene" I've awkwardly hinted at (or meant to hint at but redacting my reaction to save you quality reading time)
Wait, was there ever a knife involved? I feel like there was but in this scene I think those are just her nails digging into her skin.

Yeah ok, that's NOT schizophrenia. I don't know what that is nor do I know how you would even treat it.
"It feels strangely familiar"... Did the previous owner of the body do this?
Hey, does someone know what disorder Rin might have? If they tell you later on, you don't have to tell me of course.

How are you when you are a box of chocolates?

Rin is giving us that look and I'm not sure how to handle it...

Decided to check that wiki page for names to have the characters call you... uhh wtf is the story behind Sara and "son"!? That's a rhetorical question... Or it might, depends if this already happened and I missed it or not.
I think I just accidentally found out that she had to bury a son, maybe had a misscariage. I honestly don't know. Maybe I will find out eventually...
Well there was a few more words but nothing too exciting.

I'm gonna guess Sara was gonna invite the mc out for dinner under the pretense of it being a scouting mission of a bar. Sana didn't like the idea and started arguing with her mom insisting that she goes instead. Sara was reckless to include him in the plan when talking to Sana and Sana was suspiciously against the idea. Somehow Sana convinced Sara to just let her go instead. Sara told mc the deets and when the mc looked back, she looked upset because it was suppose to be her surprise date but it didn't go to plan and now she's stuck watching the bar. It's of course odd to let Sana go in her stead when clearly Sara cares a lot about this. I can only chalk that up to Sara revealing her and mc's secret relationship to Sana and also ruining her and Sana's relationship in the process if she didn't let Sana be the one to go.

I'm sensing a pattern here. Both Molly and Kaori have eccentric personalities and they both seem to appear at comicically convenient times.

YES! Man I love that! Yumi and mc meets Rin at the cafe and mc's explanation to why they are together is "It's our first date and she's very nervous." I love it!

Oddly specific. Death stranding reference. I mean, I guess it's not much of a reference if you just straight up say the name like that.

She's probably done her fair share of scamming or something...

Oof... that job interview was rough by the end.

And that's the second instance of the dev complaining about patreon and it happened during a Sana handholding scene... how lewd.
Wow, that rant was even more intense than the last.

Kaori just described the mc as being extraordinarily attractive, hmmm.

With a menacing look on her face, Ayane confidently flaunts the sword that will slay her foes when the time is upon us... Or something like that, I dunno, I'm not a writer.

Oh wtf, haha! "Is it really such a big deal if I get turned on by the idea of some other girl moaning my niece's name?"

You telling me the dev actually cares about copyright? That's news to me. The real hamburger man... hmm.

I love that Kaori's way of speaking has rubbed off on the mc to the extent he may now speak like her outside of a Kaori event.

That's very rich there. Of course Yumi isn't going to get over the little incident!

I swear, that has been referenced to hell, hasn't it? "would you like dinner? A bath? Or maybe... me?" example.

Sara did a tremendously good job getting on Ami's good side but this is straight up war between Makoto and Ami, my lord...

Aragofuckyourself BAHAHAHAHA!

Angy Ami is gold!

I kinda expected Ami to lose affection after that exchange.

I'm officially at the half way point in terms of main events... At least that's what it says.

Ah... What do I even say? Yumi is actually hurt? Yeah, like that wasn't already obvious, but damn.

Grassburger, hamhopper, huh.

spoilers.title: Tierlist
spoilers.html:
Haruka: Breasts are way too large for my liking but otherwise she's ok.
Kaori: Her eccentric personality is growing on me. Not a fan of the spider tattoo.


Tierlist and character notes and rules.

Being in the "not my type" tier is not necessarily fair but it's less work. Below that tier just means I haven't built a mental profile on the character yet. Children are measured by how fun they are to be around and how adorable they are, overlooking any other factor.

I don't hate any of the characters, I may just find them unremarkable and boring or can't see myself physically attracted to them.

The further top left the character is, the more I like them. Heavily affected by momentary bias.

If I didn't mention someone here, I probably don't have anything noteworthy to say yet.

Tierlists are hard, so the rankings may not be quite accurate to my true emotions and changes over time.

Sex scenes may affect where they are positioned based on momentary bias.

If the color of the tiles are the same, it means they are equally important.


Some edited since yesterday.
Yumi: I can't WAIT to see how the story with her escalates. Every time he messes with her, it's so fun and I like her appearance too.
Ayane: She's obsessed with you. Her lack of a father figure hurts her more than I realized...
Ami: Red hair, she loves you.
Chika: I expected an annoying gyaru girl who acts way too popular but I got someone chill and down to earth, fun to be around.
Makoto: I love it when he messes with her. I slightly dislike her hair and how studious she is.
Sana: Very precious.
Sara: Hot mom, I repeat, hot mom!
Maya: The mystery behind her is intriguing.
Miku: Not into tomboys.
Futaba: Not into big girls or big tits.
Rin: Nice hair. A bit bland unless Chika is around. Also seem to have a bit of a wingman personality.
Kirin: Surprisingly flirtatious... and intimidatingly so.
Karin: Absolutely adorable how bad she is with boys.
Chinami: So adorable! Must protecc!
Molly: She can be anywhere.

spoilers.title: Tierlist
spoilers.html:
Tsuneyo: This one is rough... extremely sheltered type.


Tierlist and character notes and rules.

Being in the "not my type" tier is not necessarily fair but it's less work. Below that tier just means I haven't built a mental profile on the character yet. Children are measured by how fun they are to be around and how adorable they are, overlooking any other factor.

I don't hate any of the characters, I may just find them unremarkable and boring or can't see myself physically attracted to them.

The further top left the character is, the more I like them. Heavily affected by momentary bias.

If I didn't mention someone here, I probably don't have anything noteworthy to say yet.

Tierlists are hard, so the rankings may not be quite accurate to my true emotions and changes over time.

Sex scenes may affect where they are positioned based on momentary bias.

If the color of the tiles are the same, it means they are equally important.

Chinami: So adorable! Must protecc!
Molly: She can be anywhere.
Haruka: Breasts are way too large for my liking but otherwise she's ok.
Kaori: Her eccentric personality is growing on me. Not a fan of the spider tattoo.

posts.content_html_raw:
Just to also give my two cents to the Otoha discussion (not that anyone asked):

I think it's a culmination of all the arguments brought forth so far.
Otoha is neither a psychopath, nor an angel. She isn't fully bad, but she certainly isn't good either, neither dark nor light. Which ultimately lands her pretty much in the middle at grey. Which is probably the blandest color there is.

There is a lot of arguments for hating Otoha, she did a lot of shady and unnecessarily selfish stuff - definitely. I will respect anyone's opinion for disliking her solely based on her past actions.

However, I also support the argument that her misdemeanors at least also gave her somewhat of a character. After all, she is actually the most realistic teenager out of all the girls so far.

Think about it, we have girls that (think they) talk to gods, we have heiresses of multibillion companies, we have severely abused and traumatized girls, girls that have severe depression or extreme issues with self confidence, girls that have lived millions of years and a girl that wants to be violently fucked ber her uncle who actually is her Dad.
Out of all of these individuals, I personally think, Otoha is the most "normal" one, as in, she acts the most like someone you and me would probably know in real life, at least from back in high school times.

That can of course be interpreted as being very forgettable and boring, but I see it as being a nice representation of normalcy, of an average girl, doing things that average girls do.
She is relatively calm and collected compared to most girls, she has typical hobbies that fit her age, she is facing issues that are common in her stage in life and she has flaws. Yes, she is lying, she has been manipulative, she has done selfish things and she seems constantly indecisive and unsure what to do. But almost all teenagers do exactly that.
But she did none of those things to a comically evil level, unlike someone like Nodoka or Ami. Some people even brought up that other characters did similarly heinous deeds, yet are not treated as harshly as Otoha is.
And I think it comes down to her being "too normal" to cover for her shortcomings, as she rarely does anything noteworthy enough to distract from those actions. She ultimately just wants to be left alone and do her thing.

At the end of the day, I am convinced that most of us here, if thrown into the universe of LiL, would turn out to be an 'Otoha'. Meaning, we would most likely not have any extremely outer-worldly or traumatic backstory, no crazily unusual character traits, just a pretty average person with maybe a bit of perverted tendencies here and there, but nothing too dramatic.
Thinking of it that way, I feel like I can relate to Otoha probably the most out of all the girls in this game. So what if you are relatively boring in comparison? It does not make you a bad person or unworthy of attention.

Also her butt is nice.

I've mentioned this before, but bringing the moon back makes even more sense if Sekai initially never died. Her death would be related to reset stuff, by having Maya exist, which would in turn make her die. So, while it could be "impossible" to change the real world, it would be more possible to change/change back what was altered by the fake world in the first place.
Regardless if that's true or not, another possibility is that maybe we have different moons and suns for different iterations of the world. Sekai could be one of the moons, but rather than the moon being a person, maybe it's a position. Just as we have the position of a guide to Akira being Maya, but previously it could have been Ami. So we'd have at least two "guides", one is the current guide "Maya", and the old guide was "Ami". Following that logic, the old moon could have been Sekai, and the new moon someone else.

As for the sun, it could be both Akira and Nozomu and Yuu. Different people occupying the position of the sun at different times. There isn't much merit to what I'm saying right now since I haven't structured it into a proper theory, but it remains that it is possible that "Sun", "Moon" and etcetera are positions one can occupy in the Kumon-mi kaleidoscope rather than just one person.

Another possible evidence of this is how Kaori is occupying a position that should have been occupied by Sekai, and that Pareidolia compares what she has become to what Yuu once was, and what Akira will be. Further further evidence of this is that Sekai, Akira and Yuu are all related. Hell, Akira is even mistaken for Sekai by Am I Okay.
